Reef fishes of Moorea in three habitats

Source: R/data.R
moorea_fish.Rd

Counts of 325 reef fish species in three reef habitats at 13 sites around Moorea, French Polynesia: the data of Granot, Dubiner & Belmaker (Table S2). Fish were counted on belt transects by CRIOBE between 2004 and 2018; there is one count per species, site and habitat. Only sites where a species was recorded are included for that species; all three habitats were surveyed at every site, and zeros are explicit.

Usage

moorea_fish

Format

A tibble with one row per species x site x habitat:

species

Species name.

site

Site (13 sites).

habitat

"barrier_reef", "fringing_reef" or "outer_slope".

abundance

Number of individuals counted.

Source

"MCR LTER Coral Reef Long-term Population and Community Dynamics: Fishes" in BioTIME 2.0: Dornelas, M., Antão, L. H., Bates, A. E. et al. (2025). BioTIME 2.0: expanding and improving a database of biodiversity time series. Global Ecology and Biogeography, 34(5), e70003. doi:10.1111/geb.70003

Examples

head(moorea_fish)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   species                   site      habitat       abundance
#>   <chr>                     <chr>     <chr>             <int>
#> 1 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Afareaitu barrier_reef          0
#> 2 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Afareaitu fringing_reef         1
#> 3 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Afareaitu outer_slope           0
#> 4 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Aroa      barrier_reef          8
#> 5 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Aroa      fringing_reef         7
#> 6 Abudefduf septemfasciatus Aroa      outer_slope           0
length(unique(moorea_fish$species))
#> [1] 325
